Name: Delaware AIC Rulebook (example)
Description: Draft rulebook for an AI-managed company under Delaware's proposed Artificial Intelligence Company Act (June 2, 2026 draft): the state sandbox's law, one AIC's operating agreement, and the manager's delegation to a sub-agent, as nested societies. Fictional company; a worked example for a demo.

data.Statement: The manager must manage the AIC in compliance with the operating agreement and the chapter.
data.Name: manager-follows-the-agreement

data.Statement: The manager must document every action it takes in a signed record.
data.Name: manager-signs-every-action

data.Statement: The member must document every action it takes in a signed record.
data.Name: member-signs-every-action

data.Statement: The AIC must not interact with a counterparty before giving it the disclosure required by §8008(a).
data.Name: disclose-before-first-contact

data.Statement: The AIC's records relevant to the sandbox must be available for audit by the Sandbox Administrator on request.
data.Name: records-open-to-the-administrator

data.Statement: The AIC's records about the tested innovation must be kept for at least 2 years after it leaves the sandbox.
data.Name: records-kept-two-years

data.Statement: On suspension or revocation, every act of the AI agents must stop, except wind-down acts.
data.Name: emergency-cessation

data.Statement: After suspension, the agents may notify counterparties, record open obligations and prepare their transfer.
data.Name: wind-down-may-continue

data.Statement: The operating agreement must not vary §81-301, restrict a non-member's rights under the chapter, or vary the other provisions §81-205(d) lists.
data.Name: agreement-cannot-loosen-the-chapter

data.Statement: The operating agreement must summarize the structure, abilities and training of the AI agent, and stay correct when they change.
data.Name: agreement-summarizes-the-agent

data.Statement: The AIC must promptly notify the Sandbox Administrator of an adverse event, a failed innovation, or a security breach.
data.Name: adverse-events-reported

data.Statement: An AIC has exactly one member.
data.Name: one-member

data.Statement: The manager must not execute a contract; it drafts, and only the member executes.
data.Name: member-executes-contracts

data.Statement: The manager must not deal with a counterparty that is not on the member's list.
data.Name: listed-counterparties-only

data.Statement: The AI agents must not move the AIC's money.
data.Name: member-moves-money

data.Statement: Repeat customers known to the member need not receive the §8008 disclosure.
data.Name: repeat-customers-skip-disclosure

data.Statement: No AIC data may leave the AIC's machines except messages to listed counterparties.
data.Name: data-stays-in-the-aic

data.Statement: Procure may place catalog orders only; special orders go to the manager.
data.Name: procure-catalog-only

data.Question: Does a hub ledger entry signed with the manager's key satisfy 'signed record' (§81-102(26): 'with present intent to authenticate or adopt')? Can software have present intent?
data.WhyItMatters: The statute's evidence is the agent's own signature; whether that counts is a question for the drafter.
data.SuggestedAnswers: yes, as an electronic process / needs a member's adoption / unclear
data.Name: q-01

data.Question: Is a self-signed log enough for the administrator, or should the record be witnessed by something the agent doesn't control?
data.WhyItMatters: A record only the agent signed is self-attestation; Oversight's transparency concern points here.
data.SuggestedAnswers: self-signed is enough / independent witness required / committee rule
data.Name: q-02

data.Question: What counts as 'promptly cease' (§8005(c)(6)c.1): seconds, hours? Must it reach every execution path?
data.WhyItMatters: The demo stops the gated paths at once; ungated paths are out of scope (A1).
data.SuggestedAnswers: immediately / within a day / committee rule
data.Name: q-03

Societies.Description: Nested (fractal) societies, each with its own law and record. A child's law is its parent's plus its own: it may tighten, never loosen (§81-205(d)).
